title: Postoperative pain after the application of two different irrigation devices in a prospective randomized clinical trial
use_for: Clinical outcome evidence comparing conventional needle irrigation with negative apical pressure irrigation for early postoperative pain and analgesic use in selected single-rooted teeth.

title: Treatment of stage IV periodontitis: The EFP S3 level clinical practice guideline
organization: European Federation of Periodontology / Journal of Clinical Periodontology
use_for: Complex periodontitis prognosis, staged periodontal care, tooth-retention limits, and multidisciplinary planning when periodontal support may limit endodontic investment.

title: Guided tissue regeneration for periodontal infra-bony defects
use_for: Selected periodontal guided tissue regeneration evidence for infrabony defects, including benefit-versus-predictability cautions and technique-sensitive limitations.

title: Enamel matrix derivative (Emdogain(R)) for periodontal tissue regeneration in intrabony defects
use_for: Evidence and heterogeneity cautions for enamel matrix derivative in periodontal intrabony defects, without implying guaranteed regeneration in endodontic-periodontal lesions.

title: Microscopes in Endodontics
use_for: Operating microscope and magnification framing in endodontic diagnosis and treatment, including vision enhancement, locating hidden anatomy, preserving tooth structure, and the need for visualization rather than purely digital localization.

title: Case Assessment Tools
use_for: Case assessment and referral framing, including evaluating clinical condition, treatment capability, case-assessment pitfalls, and use of the AAE case difficulty framework for treatment planning and documentation.

title: Success and Survival of Endodontically Treated Cracked Teeth with Radicular Extensions: A 2- to 4-year Prospective Cohort
use_for: Radicular-extension cracked-tooth outcome framing, including that favorable reports come from combined protocols with staged diagnosis, orifice barriers, cuspal coverage, occlusal management, and recall rather than a material-only crack repair.

title: Onset and resolution of pain among treated and untreated posterior teeth with a visible crack: Three-year findings
organization: Journal of Dentistry / National Dental Practice-Based Research Network
use_for: Longer follow-up framing for pain onset and resolution in treated and untreated posterior teeth with visible cracks, supporting risk-based monitoring rather than automatic treatment of every visible crack.

title: Symptom changes and crack progression in untreated cracked teeth: One-year findings
organization: Journal of Dentistry / National Dental Practice-Based Research Network
use_for: Short-term monitoring evidence for untreated visible posterior cracks, including symptom and crack-progression framing used to distinguish low-risk monitoring from teeth needing restoration or endodontic care.

title: Guideline on anaesthesia and sedation in breastfeeding women 2020
use_for: Breastfeeding after anesthesia or sedation, including avoiding routine breastfeeding interruption for most short-acting anesthetic/sedative agents after maternal recovery while using caution with opioids, repeated dosing, and vulnerable infants.

title: Midazolam - Drugs and Lactation Database (LactMed)
use_for: Breastfeeding sedation planning for midazolam, including low milk transfer after single-dose use, possible short nursing delay after IV dosing, and extra caution for newborn or preterm infants.

title: Nitrous Oxide use while Breastfeeding
use_for: Breastfeeding-specific nitrous oxide reference for brief procedural use, rapid elimination, and avoiding routine nursing interruption after maternal recovery.

title: Irrigants for non-surgical root canal treatment in mature permanent teeth
use_for: High-level clinical-outcome uncertainty for root-canal irrigant comparisons in mature permanent teeth, supporting cautious translation from irrigant or device studies to healing claims.

title: Root canal disinfection by single- and multiple-instrument systems: effects of sodium hypochlorite volume, concentration, and retention time
use_for: Protocol-variable framing for NaOCl disinfection, including volume, concentration, retention time, and instrumentation system interactions without treating one variable as a stand-alone healing guarantee.

title: Ultrasonic irrigant activation during root canal treatment: a systematic review
use_for: Endpoint-specific activation evidence, especially the distinction between bacterial reduction, postoperative pain, cleanliness outcomes, and uncertain healing-rate effects in apical periodontitis.

title: Effect of different concentrations of sodium hypochlorite on outcome of primary root canal treatment: a randomized controlled trial
use_for: Clinical outcome framing for NaOCl concentration comparisons in primary root canal treatment, used to keep concentration claims endpoint- and protocol-specific.

title: Periodontitis: Consensus report of workgroup 2 of the 2017 World Workshop on the Classification of Periodontal and Peri-Implant Diseases and Conditions
organization: American Academy of Periodontology / European Federation of Periodontology
use_for: Periodontitis case-definition and stage/grade prognosis framing used to keep endodontic-periodontal decisions tied to periodontal severity, complexity, risk factors, and anticipated progression.

title: Staging and grading of periodontitis: Framework and proposal of a new classification and case definition
organization: American Academy of Periodontology / European Federation of Periodontology
use_for: Stage and grade framework for translating periodontal severity, complexity, extent, risk factors, and progression into prognosis and maintenance planning around endodontically treated teeth.

title: AAE Position Statement - Use of Microscopes and Other Magnification Devices
use_for: Magnification and illumination in modern endodontics, including surgical visualization, root-end resection/filling, outcome evidence for high magnification, and the need for clinician judgment despite technology.

title: Long-term Follow-up of Cases Considered Healed One Year After Apical Microsurgery
use_for: Follow-up framing after apical microsurgery, especially the caution that one-year healed status should not be treated as a permanent outcome without longer clinical and radiographic surveillance.

title: The Correlation of Crack Lines and Definitive Restorations with the Survival and Success Rates of Cracked Teeth
use_for: Cracked-tooth survival context for the relationship among crack-line location, definitive restoration, and treatment success; used cautiously because it is observational and does not isolate a material-specific orifice-barrier effect.

title: Relationship between crown placement and the survival of endodontically treated teeth
use_for: Broad survival association between crown placement and endodontically treated teeth; supports prompt definitive restoration framing while noting it is not cracked-tooth-specific.

title: Diazepam - Drugs and Lactation Database (LactMed)
use_for: Breastfeeding sedation planning for diazepam, including repeated-dose accumulation, single-dose procedural exposure, newborn/preterm caution, and infant monitoring for sedation, poor feeding, and poor weight gain.

title: Lorazepam - Drugs and Lactation Database (LactMed)
use_for: Breastfeeding sedation planning for lorazepam, including low milk levels, shorter half-life compared with many benzodiazepines, usual-dose infant safety experience, and monitoring for infant sedation, poor feeding, and poor weight gain.

title: Hydroxyzine - Drugs and Lactation Database (LactMed)
use_for: Breastfeeding anxiolytic/antihistamine planning for hydroxyzine, including small occasional doses, larger/prolonged-dose infant drowsiness and milk-supply cautions, and preference for other agents while nursing newborn or preterm infants.

title: Distribution of sodium hypochlorite throughout the mesial root canal system of mandibular molars after adjunctive irrigant activation procedures: a micro-computed tomographic study
use_for: Irrigant distribution in extracted mandibular molars, especially endpoint-specific interpretation of XP-endo Finisher, passive ultrasonic irrigation, positive-pressure irrigation, apical distribution, and isthmus penetration.

title: The effect of supplementary methods on root canal cleaning: a study using 3D-printed mandibular molar models
use_for: Recent model-based evidence for supplementary irrigation and activation methods in complex mandibular molar anatomy, supporting NaOCl and activation as cleaning aids while preserving the need for clinical validation.

title: Periodontal Regeneration - Intrabony Defects: A Systematic Review From the AAP Regeneration Workshop
organization: Journal of Periodontology / American Academy of Periodontology
use_for: Periodontal intrabony-defect regeneration evidence and case-selection cautions; used to avoid overgeneralizing periodontal regeneration data into true combined endodontic-periodontal lesion material claims.

title: Periodontal Regeneration - Furcation Defects: A Systematic Review From the AAP Regeneration Workshop
organization: Journal of Periodontology / American Academy of Periodontology
use_for: Periodontal furcation-defect regeneration evidence and defect-specific limitations; used cautiously because furcation regeneration evidence is not direct true combined-lesion survival evidence.

title: Outcome of Endodontic Surgery: A Meta-analysis of the Literature - Part 1: Comparison of Traditional Root-end Surgery and Endodontic Microsurgery
use_for: Outcome context separating traditional root-end surgery from modern endodontic microsurgery as a treatment bundle; used cautiously and not as evidence for dynamic-navigation superiority.

title: Outcome of Endodontic Surgery: A Meta-analysis of the Literature - Part 2: Comparison of Endodontic Microsurgical Techniques with and without the Use of Higher Magnification
use_for: Magnification-specific surgical outcome context; used to support microscope/endoscope visualization within modern microsurgery while avoiding transfer to guided-surgery or navigation-product claims.

title: Occlusal veneer restoration treatment outcomes of cracked tooth syndrome: A 22.4-month follow-up study
use_for: Short-term clinical evidence for lithium-disilicate occlusal veneer restoration in selected vital cracked teeth with cold and/or biting pain but without spontaneous or nocturnal pain; used cautiously because the sample and follow-up are limited.

title: Cal. Code Regs. Tit. 16, Section 1043.1 - Permit Application Requirements
organization: California Code of Regulations / Dental Board of California
use_for: State-specific pediatric sedation permit example: California pediatric endorsement requirements for deep sedation/general anesthesia in patients under seven and moderate sedation in patients under thirteen.

title: Cal. Code Regs. Tit. 16, Section 1043.8.1 - Application for Pediatric Endorsement
organization: California Code of Regulations / Dental Board of California
use_for: State-specific pediatric endorsement example: required pediatric case documentation, current ACLS/PALS or PALS certification evidence, and records that may be requested by the Board.

title: Radiographic healing after a root canal treatment performed in single-rooted teeth with and without ultrasonic activation of the irrigant: a randomized controlled trial
use_for: Clinical healing endpoint evidence for ultrasonic irrigant activation versus syringe irrigation in single-rooted teeth with periapical bone loss; used to prevent overclaiming universal activation healing superiority.

title: Temperature evolution of preheated irrigant injected into a root canal ex vivo
use_for: Device- and delivery-specific preheated-irrigant temperature behavior, including syringe cooling, apical-patency effects, external-root temperature context, and rapid post-delivery cooling.

title: Periodontal manifestations of systemic diseases and developmental and acquired conditions: Consensus report of workgroup 3 of the 2017 World Workshop on the Classification of Periodontal and Peri-Implant Diseases and Conditions
organization: American Academy of Periodontology / European Federation of Periodontology
use_for: Tooth- and root-related periodontal modifying factors, including root fractures, cervical root resorption, cemental tears, and other local factors that can mimic or limit endodontic-periodontal lesion prognosis.
